purpose: Allow one local, bounded V2.2/V2.3 historical-context and positive replay verification using only the already collected BaoStock C3 context sample; do not make any new provider request.

source.sourceEndpoint: No network access in this proposal; input was previously collected from public-api.baostock.com:10030 under OD008-C3-LOCAL-HISTORY-20261022.
source.authorizationBasis: Owner decision for personal, local, non-commercial learning with FakeBroker/Paper only. This proposal extends neither provider terms nor the 2026-10-22 one-off probe authorization.

input.dataSemantics: RAW 5m Bars; the sample's provider-reproducible minute/daily amount and one high-price differences remain recorded limitations.

bounds.retention: Reuse only until the existing local sample retention deadline of 2026-11-21T13:22:50+08:00; do not extend retention through this decision.
bounds.sharing: No sharing, publishing, or raw-market-data commit.
bounds.execution: One isolated TestRun, FakeBroker only, no strategy activation, no order placement, no LIVE broker, no recurring task.

knownLimitations: The source is not approved for new collection or broad historical research by this proposal.
Daily trading status does not prove per-minute suspension facts; unresolved values stay UNKNOWN/null.
Corporate actions and MarketRuleSet evidence are partial and must be registered with their explicit scope before preflight.
A successful bounded replay proves only the recorded local software path and cannot be presented as strategy profitability or complete historical fact validation.
approvalEffect: Only an explicit owner confirmation may convert this proposal into an approved decision record and enable the listed configuration for the isolated verification.
